value.description: Craft long-range war bows: greatbows, longbows and warbows.
Tailor everyday modern clothing: casual wear, formal wear, work attire and sterile medical clothing.
Craft weatherproof military outfits for your soldiers, including ghillie camouflage.
Tailor and craft eltex apparel and weapons that improve the psychic focus of your psycasters.
Unlocks the ability to construct specialized work drones, hunter drone packs and traps, and the infrastructure to keep them operational.
